## Description
Briefly explain the change and motivation behind it.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New functionality (backwards-compatible)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (backwards-compatible)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without functional change
- [ ] `chore`: Dependency updates or build tooling
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates only

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch name conforms to convention (`type/short-kebab-description`)
- [ ] No real patient data / PHI committed
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive configuration committed
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] Pre-commit / linter passes
